method: Analytic transfer-matrix bounds for the uniform right Robin half-spectrum; residue formula from normalized half-spectrum characteristic functions; absolute aggregation of the double-residue series; inverse-Laplace saddle expansion of the exact hyperbolic transfer-matrix ratio.
computation: No new certified eigenvalue computation or numerical scan was used. The low-mode ordering is inherited from the previously archived interval certificate. The coefficient and tail bounds are analytic.
assumptions: Static-tie benchmark with common first half-spectrum eigenvalue c
Uniform right half with length 1/2, diffusivity 1, Robin parameter kappa>0
Simple half-spectrum roots and the established residue expansion
